body:
The candidate16 installed matrix's T23 fixture still requires saves to have moved and a recovery record to exist after refusing foreign content. The #479 source fix deliberately checks content before any tier advances or a recovery record is created, preventing a refused destination from acquiring false interrupted-copy provenance. Matrix01 refused the content correctly, then its old expected-destination read failed.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: use the unchanged candidate16 image and owned local cloud, compare every original cloud byte and all settings pointers before/after refusal, require no recovery record, repeat the refusal, and verify the stronger invariant rejects the actual prior migration script in a private QA path.

- [x] Preserve matrix01's actual failure, all case results, source seals and verified guest/backend cleanup.
- [x] Correct the T23 acceptance to require unchanged cloud/config/pointers and no created record; retain the foreign-destination and no-complete-marker checks.
- [x] A fresh installed VM check passes the stronger invariant, rejects the actual old-script control, and leaves all installed binaries unchanged with verified cleanup.

Refs #479, #471. No product modification or new build is implied by this fixture correction.


Verified resolution, 2026-10-07: [matrix01](<https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/7b9dae4ac0be43c533ac7cdbc142d383a8ca940c/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-pixelelated-replacement-16/p4-build16-installed-matrix-01/>) retains84 PASS/1 FAIL with allfour1/212 seals and actual cleanup verified00:37:46. [Collision01](<https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/7b9dae4ac0be43c533ac7cdbc142d383a8ca940c/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-pixelelated-replacement-16/p4-build16-collision-01/>) passes two unchanged-state refusals, rejects the actual candidate15 migration source by the same invariant, verifies original bytes and unchanged installed binaries, and passes allfour0/212 seals/actual cleanup at00:39:10. The canonical observer correction landed in feature `674f4312ffd75c47a5bde8f5dbb4c5df9f941557` and next `7b9dae4ac0be43c533ac7cdbc142d383a8ca940c` with normal hooks and exact remote readback. No product rebuild or original-result relabeling.
title: M7.P4: Verify collision refusal before any migration writes
